source: AISC Companion to the Manual v16.0, Vol. 1: Design Examples (R-STEEL-EXAMPLES), Chapter I: Examples I.1 (composite beam, Manual tables) and I.2 (composite girder, direct calculation); LRFD. US customary as published; 'rounding' is half a unit of the last published digit unless a basis is given.

Qn1.basis: Manual Table 3-20, one stud per rib, weak position

phiMn386.basis: Manual Table 3-18, PNA location 5 (bottom of flange), ΣQn = 386 kips; table values to three figures

ILB.basis: Manual Table 3-19 for Y2 = 7.00 in. (rounded) and PNA location 5; the direct C-I3-1 value with the exact d1 differs by its rounding

phiMnSteel.basis: 0.90 Fy Zx, continuously braced during construction

discrepancies: The example selects the section from Manual Tables 3-18/3-19 (not held); the workbench computes φM_n and I_LB directly from Commentary C-I3-10 and C-I3-1, which reproduce the tabulated values within their rounding.

x560.basis: PNA depth in the top flange for C = 560 kips

Mn560.basis: the example takes d3 = 12.0 in. for d/2 = 11.95 in. and prints 17,000 kip-in. to three figures; with the exact inputs M_n = 1,408 kip-ft (16,897 kip-in.)

ILB.basis: from d3 = 12.0 in. (d/2 = 11.95 in.); exact 4,719 in.^4, and 4,733 in.^4 with the example's rounded inputs

n.basis: E_c = 3,492 ksi exactly; the example rounds it to 3,490 ksi (n = 8.309)

Itr.basis: from n = 8.31 and d/2 = 12.0 in.; exact 6,772 in.^4, 6,798 in.^4 with the rounded inputs

enaInDeck.basis: from n = 8.31 and d/2 = 12.0 in.; exact 2.854 in.

Iequiv.basis: from the rounded I_tr; exact 5,465 in.^4

deltaLive.basis: with the example's I_LB = 4,730 in.^4; with the exact 4,719 in.^4 it is 0.5446 in.

phiMnConstruction.basis: Manual Eq. 3-4a with tabulated φbBF = 22.6 kips and φbMpx = 750 kip-ft

discrepancies: The example places pairs of studs at the ends and single studs in the middle third; the workbench models a uniform layout, so the stud-force comparison uses the example's ΣQn values (560 and 581 kips) directly.

The example rounds d/2 = 11.95 in. to 12.0 in. and E_c to 3,490 ksi; with those inputs the workbench reproduces its I_LB, Y_ENA, I_tr, I_equiv and M_n (test example_i_2_with_its_rounded_inputs). With the exact inputs the values differ by those roundings only.
